chat.body: Why does EditOrderPage take the id from the route instead of from the order it loaded?

`handleSubmit` in `EditOrderPage.vue` spreads the draft and then sets `id: orderId`, which comes from `route.params.orderId`, so the request path and the body always name the same order. The loaded order has the same id, so the two only differ if the route changes while the page is open.
